government.note: Semi-presidential republic under the 1991 Constitution (revised by referendum in 2003). The directly elected President (two-round system; four-year term until 2004, five years since the 2003 revision; at most two terms) nominates the Prime Minister, whose government needs a vote of confidence from Parliament and can be dismissed by a motion of no confidence (as in 2021). Parliament can suspend the President, who is then dismissed only if voters approve it in a referendum (Băsescu was suspended in 2007 and 2012 and returned both times). The President of the Senate acts during a suspension or vacancy. On 1 January 2000 President Constantinescu (elected for the CDR) and the CDR-USD-UDMR coalition under the non-party Prime Minister Isărescu (appointed 22 December 1999) were in office. The first round of the November 2024 presidential election was annulled by the Constitutional Court; Iohannis stayed in office until he resigned on 12 February 2025.

reserved_seats.group: recognised national minorities (one seat per organisation passing a lower threshold)

system.note: Party-list PR in 43 constituencies (41 counties, Bucharest and the diaspora): seats are first allocated by Hare quota in each constituency, then remaining seats nationally by D'Hondt. Threshold 5% for parties (or 20% in four constituencies), 8-10% for alliances. Ethnic-minority organisations that do not pass the threshold can win one seat each (18 seats in 2024). The 2008 and 2012 elections used a mixed-member system with single-member colleges and supplementary seats. Chamber size changes with population: 343 (1996), 345 (2000), 332 (2004), 334 (2008), 412 (2012), 329 (2016), 330 (2020), 331 (2024); the schema records one size (the 2000 start). seats_2000 is the result of the November 1996 election, split by party using the CDR, USD and PSDR articles (PSDR 10 of the USD's 53, so PD 43); 'others' holds 13 minor CDR members (PNL-CD 4, PAR 3, PER 5, FER 1) and 15 minority seats. Defections during the term (e.g. to the Alliance for Romania) were not checked.
